CuiDong.title: Activation
CuiDong.description: Gu cards can be played directly from the Gu Hand. After all available activations are spent, they enter the Gu Cooldown Pile.

HeLian.title: Fusion
HeLian.description: Consumes the specified Gu materials to refine a new Gu. Its rank follows the recipe and it is normally excluded from rewards.

KeXue.title: Bloodthirst
KeXue.description: Spend the listed Blood Essence to trigger the stated effect.

ZongEDu.title: Shared Total
ZongEDu.description: The listed amount is shared among all living enemies.

YiChu.title: Overflow
YiChu.description: Amount above the resource cap converts as stated on the card.

ZhuiJi.title: Pursuit
ZhuiJi.description: If the target dies, remaining hits move to another enemy.

YaoHua1.title: Illumination 1
YaoHua1.description: When you have at least 1 Radiance, automatically spend 1 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua2.title: Illumination 2
YaoHua2.description: When you have at least 2 Radiance, automatically spend 2 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua3.title: Illumination 3
YaoHua3.description: When you have at least 3 Radiance, automatically spend 3 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua4.title: Illumination 4
YaoHua4.description: When you have at least 4 Radiance, automatically spend 4 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua5.title: Illumination 5
YaoHua5.description: When you have at least 5 Radiance, automatically spend 5 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua6.title: Illumination 6
YaoHua6.description: When you have at least 6 Radiance, automatically spend 6 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua7.title: Illumination 7
YaoHua7.description: When you have at least 7 Radiance, automatically spend 7 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua8.title: Illumination 8
YaoHua8.description: When you have at least 8 Radiance, automatically spend 8 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua9.title: Illumination 9
YaoHua9.description: When you have at least 9 Radiance, automatically spend 9 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

XuYing.title: Phantom
XuYing.description: Automatically Retained and cannot be played manually. After a non-Phantom Attack resolves, manifests at the listed chance. Phantoms do not trigger other Phantoms.

LianLi.title: Strength Refinement
LianLi.description: Beast Gu begin combat sealed. Each first effective resolution of the matching Companion advances the first sealed Gu of that type by 1. At 3, it immediately unseals and joins the Gu draw sequence. Progress lasts only for this combat.

NianHua.title: Years
NianHua.description: Time Path resource. At 6, trigger Yearful and reset to 0; excess Years continue resolving.

SuiMan.title: Yearful
SuiMan.description: Choose 1 Gu in cooldown and shorten its cooldown by 1 turn; extend all timed enemy debuffs by 1 turn.

HuanBu.title: Slow Step
HuanBu.description: Slow Step X reduces the enemy's total damage for each attack action by X; multi-hit attacks share the amount. Duration is shown on the card.

XiYing.title: Past Echo
XiYing.description: A temporary normal-card copy created by Backtrack. It Exhausts and cannot be copied by Backtrack again; playing it grants Years as shown on Backtrack Gu.

PoShi.title: Break Stance
PoShi.description: Triggers when this effect reduces an enemy's existing Block to 0.

XueJiCost.title: Blood Rite
XueJiCost.description: Spend the listed Blood Essence first; each missing point costs 2 HP instead, leaving at least 1 HP.

LianHai1.title: Refine Remains 1
LianHai1.description: Consume up to 1 Remains; see the card for the payoff.

LianHai2.title: Refine Remains 2
LianHai2.description: Consume up to 2 Remains; see the card for the payoff.

LianHai3.title: Refine Remains 3
LianHai3.description: Consume up to 3 Remains; see the card for the payoff.

XueQiCore.title: Blood Qi
XueQiCore.description: Triggers an effect based on the host type and may trigger multiple times.

XueYueCore.title: Blood Moon
XueYueCore.description: Progresses through Crescent, Waxing, and Full Moon, advancing one stage each trigger.

XueTaiCore.title: Blood Fetus
XueTaiCore.description: Triggers by host type, may devour another parasite to inherit progress, and triggers its final effect at progress 3.

ShangShi.title: Injury
ShangShi.description: Based on current HP: 75% or less is Light Injury, 50% or less Heavy Injury, and 25% or less Critical Injury.

ZheGuangCore.title: Refraction
ZheGuangCore.description: When a Light Path card differs in type from the previous standard card, trigger Refraction and gain 1 Radiance, up to 3 per turn. Some cards gain the listed bonus after Refraction.

ZhaoXi.title: Marked Strike
ZhaoXi.description: When attacking an enemy that already has Zhao Po, trigger the listed Marked Strike effect.

YanGuang.title: Light Spawn
YanGuang.description: After entering cooldown, generate the derived card shown in this card's current preview. At Rank 3 it goes to discard; Rank 4+ grants it at the start of a cooldown turn.

YingGuang.title: Imprinted Light
YingGuang.description: The first hit of your next Attack gains the listed damage if it hits an enemy that already has Zhao Po, then this effect is removed.

ShouHui.title: Guarded Radiance
ShouHui.description: At turn end, if you still have at least 5 Block, gain 1 Radiance.

PoHui.title: Broken Radiance
PoHui.description: The first time your Block is fully broken this turn, gain 1 Radiance.

ShiXue.title: Blood Hunt
ShiXue.description: If the initial target already has Bleed, attack 1 additional time.

restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_GU_RANK_UP.d: Select Gu Worms to refine in one go. Each refinement has 2 slots: a mortal Gu Worm takes 1 slot and an immortal Gu Worm takes 2 slots, so you can refine up to 2 mortal or 1 immortal Gu Worm. Each selected Gu Worm gains one rank, including rank 5 to rank 6. Confirming with 0 selected cancels. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_GU_RANK_UP.s: Select Gu Worms to refine (mortal takes 1 slot each, immortal takes 2 slots each, 2 slots total). You may also confirm with 0 selected.

restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_HE_LIAN.desc: First select a currently craftable Gu card, then select Gu Worm materials matching that target. Materials are consumed and the result is created only when both types and quantities match; failed attempts do not consume the use. Fusion can succeed once per rest site.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_HE_LIAN.sele: Select materials matching the target Gu card, then confirm.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_HE_LIAN.targ: First select the Gu card to craft. Only materials that can match the target will be shown next.

combatInterfaceLocalizationFallbacks.text: Blood Parasite
A parasite enchantment that persists, clones, and renders with its host without consuming the normal enchantment slot. Its kind, stage, and values are shown in the host card text.
Blood Parasite Composite
Internal carrier for one normal enchantment and one Blood Parasite enchantment.
Gu Hand
The Gu Hand holds up to 5 usable Gu Worms. When space is available, Gu enter from the Gu Storage Pile in cooldown-completion order. Killer Move deduction can use only materials in the Gu Hand.
The Gu Hand is empty.
Select Gu Worm materials matching the selected Killer Move, then confirm.
First select the Killer Move to deduce. Only matching materials will be shown next.
Gu Storage Pile
Stores fully cooled Gu waiting to enter the Gu Hand. When the Gu Hand has room, they enter in cooldown-completion order. Left-click to inspect.
The Gu Storage Pile is empty.
Gu Cooldown Pile
Stores only Gu that are still cooling down. After all activations are spent, a Gu enters this pile; when cooldown completes it returns to the Gu Storage Pile. Left-click to inspect.
The Gu Cooldown Pile is empty.
Bitter Strength
After an Attack fully resolves, add Labor damage based on current Injury. Higher ranks grant Strength the first time you enter worse Injury tiers.
Self-Reliance
Wait for the next Attack to fully resolve, then heal based on actual HP damage to its main target. Higher ranks can include attached follow-up Strength Path damage.
Self Strength
Count Beast Phantom manifestations and gain 1 Strength at the listed threshold. Rank 7+ also grants 1 Strength when 3 different Beast Phantoms manifest in one turn, once per turn.
Group Strength

After a Beast Phantom naturally manifests, roll the listed chance to continue until failure or the limit. Extra manifestations cannot retrigger Group Strength; Rank 6+ counts them as actual manifestations.
Wo Li Temporary HP
Temporary HP granted by Wo Li Phantoms; every 5 points lost from this source consumes 1 Wo Li Phantom.
Brilliance

A character resource capped at 9. Brilliance does not disappear at end of turn; Light Path cards can gain or spend it. Refraction: when the previous standard card you played has a different type, a Light Path card gains 1 Brilliance (up to 3 per turn).
Illumination Break
The next time a single hit from an Attack card deals damage, take 3 additional damage and remove 1 Illumination Break. Multi-hit attacks can consume multiple stacks.
Blood Essence
Blood Path resource, maximum 12.
Blood Mark
When damaged by the applier’s Blood Path attack, consume 1 stack and lose 3 extra HP; each card play refunds at most 1 Blood Essence across all enemies.
Bleed
At turn end, lose 1 stack and take 3 damage; the applier gains 1 Blood Essence.
Blood Qi Recovery
At the start of your next turn, heal {Amount} HP, then remove this effect.
Primeval Essence

Primeval essence stored in a Gu Master's aperture. Begin each combat with the amount granted by your aperture rank (rank 1: 4, rank 9: 8); from turn 2 onward, restore 2-4 each turn by rank (1-2: 2, 3-5: 3, 6-9: 4). Maximum essence rises with aperture rank: 5/5/6/6/7/7/8/8/9.
Blood Skull
Maximum 3. Empowers some Blood Parasite, defense, and Blood Bat effects.
Blood Parasite
Attaches to a normal card and triggers after the host fully resolves; exhausting the host early removes the parasite and grants 1 Blood Essence.
Blood River After-Armor
At the start of your next turn, gain {Amount} Block, then remove this effect.
Myriad Remains After-Armor
At the start of your next turn, gain {Amount} Block, then remove this effect.
Shine
The first hit of your next Light Path Attack deals {Amount} more damage. Multi-hit attacks gain this bonus only once.
Years
You have {Amount}/6 Years. At 6, trigger Yearful.
Passing Time
Gain Years when Gu finish cooldown; trigger limits and extra Yearful rewards are shown on the matching Companion Power.
Year after Year
Gain Years on the interval shown by the matching Companion Power, with possible extra Years after Yearful.
Time Anchor
After each Yearful, regain Years; higher ranks also draw on every 2nd Yearful.
Years Flow Like Water
The first Yearful each turn grants the matching Yearflow card.
Third Watch
The next {Amount} times you gain Years, gain 1 more.
Slow Steps
Each attack action shares a fixed damage-reduction pool; {Amount} turns remaining.
Stored Month
Years scheduled by Month Gu will arrive at future turn starts.
Past Echo Watcher
Hidden watcher for Past Echo cards.
Return to Heaven
Records the highest actual HP damage dealt by a later single card. The first time you would die, heal the listed percentage and survive; otherwise heal after combat. Triggers once.
